api:
<NightingaleRose data={causes} sectors={months} name={|c: &Cause| c.name} value={|c: &Cause, month: usize| c.deaths[month]} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas above: one row per stacked seriesrequired
sectorsVec<SharedString>: one wedge each, clockwise from the toprequired
nameFn(&T) -> &strrequired
valueFn(&T, usize) -> f64: the row's value in sector indexrequired
maxf64: the stacked total at the rimthe largest stacked total
levelsusize: grid rings4
fill_opacityf320.85
legend, tooltip, classas on <Spider>

Rows are stacked outwards in each sector. Each wedge's area follows its value: the radius grows with the square root, as in Nightingale's original. It shares the polar painter, legend and tooltip with <Spider>.

examples.title: Causes of death
examples.description: Florence Nightingale's 1854–55 data: wedge area, not radius, grows with deaths; hover a month.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn crimean_war() {
    let data = use_signal(crimea());
    rsx! { <NightingaleRose data={data} sectors={months()} name={|c: &Cause| c.name} value={|c: &Cause, month: usize| c.deaths[month]} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: One cause
examples.description: Deaths from disease alone, lighter and without a legend.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn single() {
    let data = use_signal(crimea().into_iter().take(1).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    rsx! { <NightingaleRose data={data} sectors={months()} name={|c: &Cause| c.name} value={|c: &Cause, month: usize| c.deaths[month]} levels={3} fill_opacity={0.6} legend={Legend::hidden()} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Monthly rainfall
examples.description: Three climates stacked per month, with the legend on the right.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn rainfall() {
    let data = use_signal(series(&[
        (
            "Seattle",
            &[
                140., 95., 90., 60., 45., 35., 15., 20., 40., 80., 150., 160.,
            ],
        ),
        (
            "Mumbai",
            &[3., 3., 3., 12., 40., 520., 710., 440., 320., 90., 25., 5.],
        ),
        ("Cairo", &[5., 4., 3., 1., 0.5, 0., 0., 0., 0., 1., 3., 5.]),
    ]));
    rsx! { <NightingaleRose data={data} sectors={calendar()} name={|s: &Series| s.name} value={|s: &Series, month: usize| s.values[month]} legend={Legend::list().right()} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Weekday visits
examples.description: Seven wedges for web and app traffic.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn weekdays() {
    let data = use_signal(series(&[
        ("Web", &[820., 910., 880., 930., 760., 420., 380.]),
        ("App", &[540., 560., 590., 610., 700., 880., 840.]),
    ]));
    rsx! { <NightingaleRose data={data} sectors={labels(&["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"])} name={|s: &Series| s.name} value={|s: &Series, day: usize| s.values[day]} fill_opacity={0.7} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Emergency calls

examples.code:

        ("Calls", &[12., 5., 18., 64., 92., 70., 55., 31.]),
        ("Escalated", &[2., 1., 3., 9., 14., 10., 8., 5.]),

    rsx! { <NightingaleRose data={data} sectors={labels(&["00–03", "03–06", "06–09", "09–12", "12–15", "15–18", "18–21", "21–24"])} name={|s: &Series| s.name} value={|s: &Series, block: usize| s.values[block]} levels={2} fill_opacity={1.} legend={Legend::hidden()} class="h-80" /> }
